title: Laredo police promote three lieutenants, two sergeants
excerpt: Chief Miguel Rodriguez administered the oath of office to the department's newly promoted lieutenants, the department said, and two sergeants were promoted last Friday.
content:
The Laredo Police Department has promoted three officers to lieutenant and two to sergeant, the department announced.

Tyler J. Tijerina, Robert M. Garza and Jose A. Lopez were promoted to the rank of lieutenant, and Laredo Police Chief Miguel Rodriguez administered the oath of office, officially promoting them, according to the department.

Vicente Rodriguez Jr. and Steven Moncivais were promoted to sergeant last Friday, the department said.

The department congratulated the five officers on their hard work, dedication and commitment to the department and the community.

Source: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 10, 2026.
